novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The displayed IPCW recovery identity is a standard right-censoring functional, so it should be absorbed as a cited standard lemma rather than presented as a novel root result.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2 / Proposition 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The capacity fiber and strict-support diagnostic lack a worked primitive small-instance exhibit computing capacities, a feasible lift, and the claimed nonrectangular support, which caps the proposed new-object contribution at field tier.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6 and def:observable-moment-outer-set
soundness_flags.one_line: The radius uses N_zx even for p_x and is undefined at N_zx=0 despite the theorem claiming zero-cell validity; the construction must explicitly set zero-cell intervals to [0,1] and specify the p_x radius and censoring constraints.

soundness_flags.label: ass:independent-censoring
soundness_flags.one_line: Joint independence of C from all four potential event paths is stronger than needed for each observed arm margin; arm-specific independent censoring suffices for the displayed IPCW and outer-set primitives.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the IPCW estimator n^{-1} sum_i delta_i f(T_i,Z_i)/Ghat(T_i-) under independent censoring as the standard recovery device for a censored expectation.
The article defines TV-SACE and RM-SACE, uses an illness--death frailty model, and implements posterior imputation of potential outcomes.
The paper obtains sharp SACE bounds by reducing the fractional target to symbolic/parametric linear programming and integrating pointwise bounds.
The paper represents causal partial identification with multi-marginal optimal transport, gives an exact population identified set, and analyzes plug-in rates for selected quadratic objectives.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a three-horizon finite-grid exhibit with explicit within-arm tables, every marked capacity, one feasible full-law lift, the chain-flow certificate, and the numerical cross-cohort support calculation.

Repair the finite-sample construction by defining zero-cell and p_x intervals, giving explicit censoring-bin equalities/inequalities, and proving the single simultaneous primitive event used for containment.
Demote the IPCW identity to a cited standard lemma and focus the headline on the necessary-and-sufficient marked-capacity lift, common extremizers, and joint-surface separation.
Replace all-cross-world censoring independence with the minimally sufficient arm-specific condition, or justify why the stronger condition is scientifically required.

recommended_next_step: Revise the exhibit and finite-sample definition, then retain the marked-capacity sharpness kernel as a field-tier partial-identification project.
